limits.description: Only one 1647 printed copy collated; no independent author autograph/manuscript or alternate edition checked.
The society's 1647 legal/social servant/master framework is historical testimony, not modern employment or human-rights advice.
The source uses 'conjunction' broadly 'by body or aspect'; conjunction terminology is not silently modernized.
The distinction between 'determinate and not absolute' questions and paired examples of particular-versus-ever freedom has ambiguous wording.
The first Sun fallback depends on failure of two Moon/ascendant-lord comparisons, not an unconditional Sun criterion.
The directional condition of angular planet direct versus retrograde is source-local and conditional on earlier presence/conjunction.
The phrase few minutes separated has no universal measured threshold, no ephemeris implementation here.
'Entr ing combustion' must remain distinct from already combust Sun aspects; printed typography and start moment unspecified.
The heading Seventh House after Finis Sexæ Domus is a new source section despite no new numbered chapter.
The forty-three general horary aphorisms differ from the previously indexed forty-three physician aphorisms of Lilly XLIV.
Aphorism1 'one nature or Triplicity' does not provide a modern reproducible exact-hour construction.
Aphorism2 few/late ascending degrees does not state an exact numerical cutoff.
Aphorism3 node-like glyph in tenth may be copy-specific; identify on source image rather than infer from typography.
Aphorism5 Moon strength and 'virtue transmission' are 1647 doctrine, not observed mechanism.
Aphorism6 cold and heat refer to virtue/operation rather than physical thermodynamic temperature.
Aphorism9 void-of-course Moon exceptions are Cancer Taurus Sagittarius Pisces; exact OCR node/sign glyphs require visual read.
Aphorism16 'do so when Fortunes are Significators' is elliptic; cannot safely synthesize a fully symmetric calculation.
Aphorism20 dignified Saturn/Mars near angles is an explicit exception to a generally malefic-class prediction.
Aphorism26 under-beams is within 12 degrees of Sun; cazimi source threshold sixteen arcminutes. Endpoint inclusive ambiguity.
Aphorism27 source distinguishes oriental Saturn/Jupiter/Mars from Venus/Mercury reversal of timing.
Aphorism28 common-sign probable-but-not-concluded is not a calibrated prediction probability.
Aphorism29 states Head or Tail Dragon may harm, not a default north-node positive reading.
Aphorism30 'eclipse at hand' requires a separate historic eclipse ephemeris not supplied.
Aphorism32 Mercury-in-Sagittarius/Pisces example is source-specific; 'opposite own house' may not imply all signs are uniformly opposite.
Aphorism35 Moon conjunct Sun/combustion magnitude is author assertion not independent medical or predictive evidence.
Aphorism36 the grouping of both-significators' multiple negative conditions is syntactically uncertain.
Aphorism39 circle/fortune glyph read as Part-of-Fortune-like with source-qualified identity.
Aphorism40 seventh-house malefic natal-significator exception requires independently known birth-chart role and must be retained.
Aphorism41 woman death/deceased men's debts are distinct source claims without verification.
Aphorism42 printed Jupiter-and-Venus phrase may enumerate Fortune planets, not require simultaneous co-location.
Aphorism43 printed Dragon Tail glyph identification is image-dependent; no verified modern risk prediction.
Original handwritten margins of surviving scan are not presumed 1647-authorial.
43 source rules are not 43 patients, forecast trials or tested successes.
No selective printed erratum for pp296–302 is not proof absence of other printer errors.
No comparison to historical Swiss-ephemeris positions, independent interpretations, or untouched human experiments has been performed.
